selectionDefinition: benchmark/holdouts/temporal-holdout-v1.json (merged as PR #163); the execution protocol pins exactly its primaryTasks

taskDriftAudit.result: all ten pinned task trees are byte-identical between the task source commit and the audit commit; zero drift
taskDriftAudit.policy: formal T2 uses the PINNED task trees only; living-main edits to any of the ten tasks never propagate into this execution

modelResolutionPolicy.dryResolution: not-locally-resolvable: Harbor 0.22.0 resolves model IDs against the provider at run time and ships no offline model catalog
modelResolutionPolicy.repoEvidence: both IDs are recorded in the repository's merged 2026-09-01 validation reports as previously resolved by Harbor (gpt-5.6-luna via codex; deepseek-v4-flash via terminus-2)
modelResolutionPolicy.mismatchPolicy: the resolved model identity is recorded per slot; any resolved-model mismatch with the preregistered ID is an infra failure — the slot is marked invalid-infra and receives at most one replacement; no silent model substitution is allowed

conditionDefinitions.frozen-skill: the frozen skill is materialized from skillSourceCommit:skills/plugin-upgrade ONLY (tree 817a48e6..., SKILL.md blob a3ee71d3...), verified against a file SHA-256 manifest before any slot; no other skill, no extra hints
conditionDefinitions.no-injected-skill: no Skill is mounted and no skill-related prompt augmentation is added; nothing else about the task prompt changes

materialization.skill: extract 5f7234ba...:skills/plugin-upgrade from local git objects; verify the tree and SKILL.md blob match the pinned values; emit a file SHA-256 manifest used as the mount provenance
materialization.tasks: extract benchmark/tasks/<id> for each of the ten pinned trees from d4f7e8c...; record per-task tree SHA, instruction blob, task.toml blob, and tests/judge tree before scheduling
materialization.prohibition: never copy the living checkout's task files and 'fix them back'; the pinned git objects are the only source

scheduleAlgorithm: for each model × task group, digest = sha256(scheduleSeed + '|' + model + '|' + task); the first digest byte's parity selects the sequence ABBAAB (even) or BAABBA (odd), where A = frozen-skill and B = no-injected-skill; each condition contributes exactly 3 slots with attempts 1..3 in the sequence's order for that condition; groups are ordered model-major then task order; slots are numbered 1..120 sequentially

timeoutPolicy.agent: 3 × the task's own pinned [agent] timeout_sec (repository-validated precedent from the 2026-08-31 auth-v1 report); per-task values: H4 900s, H7 2700s, H13 2700s, M3 2700s, M4 2700s, S8 900s, H20 2700s, H21 2700s, M13 2700s, M14 2700s
timeoutPolicy.verifier: the task's own pinned [verifier] timeout_sec, unchanged
timeoutPolicy.mutation: timeouts are frozen by this protocol; changing any of them after slot 1 aborts execution-v1

networkPolicy.taskContainerOutbound: disabled — enforced technically (network namespace / nftables / equivalent isolation), not by prompt instruction
networkPolicy.loopbackAndTaskLocalServices: allowed where the task requires them
networkPolicy.formalHostRequirements: Linux host, Harbor 0.22-compatible, with a working enforcement mechanism; macOS Docker Desktop is NOT an acceptable no-network authority
networkPolicy.canary: before formal slot 1, a model-free canary must run inside a task container: external DNS and HTTPS must FAIL, required loopback services must PASS; the canary record includes OS/kernel, Docker server version, Harbor version, the isolation mechanism, and the timestamped result
networkPolicy.canaryFailure: HARD STOP — zero formal model slots are executed until the enforcement is fixed and re-canaried

replacementPolicy.rules: original artifacts are retained and marked invalid-infra; at most ONE replacement per slot; the replacement keeps the same model, task, condition, and logical attempt; the physical attempt is suffixed R1
replacementPolicy.nonReplaceableRule: these are valid scientific outcomes and are never re-run toward success

artifactPolicy.noTmpOnly: artifacts must live under a persistent root; /tmp-only or ephemeral CI-only retention is prohibited
artifactPolicy.manifests: a SHA-256 manifest per trial immediately after completion; an aggregate manifest after the full experiment
artifactPolicy.cleanup: no automatic cleanup; artifacts are retained at least until the paper review cycle concludes

activationPolicy.rule: skill-supplied does not imply skill-opened; the existing activation auditor's verified schema support does not extend to terminus-2 trajectories without prior validation, so no activation claim is made by this protocol

analysisPolicy.primaryModelEffect: mean of taskDelta over the 10 tasks
analysisPolicy.noRewardSemantics: NO REWARD is an anomaly/incomplete outcome, never a zero; the existing summarize-runs.mjs semantics are reused and no conflicting parser is introduced

bootstrap.unit: task (paired task deltas, not individual trials)

wilcoxon.zeroHandling: zeros are retained; ties receive the standard midpoint rank; decided before any result is observed

retainedGain.referenceEligibility: a reference is usable only when it matches the formal run on: same model, same agent, same reasoning setting, same network policy, same 3-run per-task median design, same reward semantics, and a comparable intervention
retainedGain.fallback: retainedGain = not-estimable-yet until such a reference exists; earlier networked calibrations (e.g. H21) are context, never the denominator

midRunMutationPolicy.rule: after formal slot 1 starts, any change to tasks, judges, skill, protocol, schedule, agent, model, reasoning, Harbor version, network policy, timeouts, or analysis method aborts temporal-holdout-execution-v1; partial evidence is retained and a protocol v2 restarts from slot 1
midRunMutationPolicy.prohibition: never continue 61/120 after changing a grader

privacyPolicy.rule: no private plugin names, private repositories, machine paths, tokens, API keys, or credentials appear in any committed protocol artifact
